controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Hubble's spectrum of the star. The disc is unresolved; its darker edge follows a model limb-darkening law, not a measurement.
controls.notes: The colour of the Hubble Space Telescope's calibrated STIS spectrum of Sirius A, the CALSPEC flux standard. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
